subject.title: feat: add interactive launcher menu as thin wrapper over existing CLI

question: Should OpenClaw core own a new Rust interactive launcher menu, or should launch ergonomics stay in the existing CLI, onboarding, web UI, and companion-app tracks for now?
rationale: This PR is not only a mechanical patch; it adds a new setup/startup and Rust build surface that needs owner commitment before repair automation can safely reshape it.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow launcher redesign
options.body: Keep the direction alive only if the branch is narrowed to launcher files, preserves current CLI behavior, wires build/package support, and proves real flows.

options.title: Decline core launcher for now
options.body: Close or pause this PR and direct launch ergonomics toward existing onboarding, CLI, web UI, or companion-app work until maintainers explicitly sponsor the surface.

options.title: Accept core launcher ownership
options.body: Own the Rust launcher, packaging, upgrade, and support burden deliberately despite the added toolchain and compatibility responsibilities.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow launcher redesign
recommendation.body: Keep the direction alive only if the branch is narrowed to launcher files, preserves current CLI behavior, wires build/package support, and proves real flows.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest product-direction signal for platform app and launch ergonomics from the related umbrella discussion.
